phases.label: Web-first intake
phases.notes: Official docs for Git, AI coding tools, and AgentCore-style platform boundaries were checked.

phases.label: Mode, boundary, and plan
phases.notes: Selected governance mode and decomposed the broad product split.

phases.label: Requirements and spec
phases.notes: Created shared/project requirements, specs, traceability, and history records.

phases.label: Implementation
phases.notes: Updated product/view registries, snapshot collector, UI, styles, tests, and README/project boundaries.

phases.label: Verification
phases.notes: Config contract, collector, workspace-monitor check/test/build, platform-desktop-app test/check, Browser smoke, and git diff check were run or queued for final diff validation.

phases.label: Evaluation and rework
phases.notes: Omission, resource, and work evaluation records were updated and checked.

phases.label: Commit and push
phases.notes: Staged, committed, and pushed after final validation.

bottleneck_analysis.bottleneck_notes: The broadest cost was updating cross-cutting product copy, snapshot contracts, and tests without changing unrelated runtime behavior.
improvement_candidates: Continue componentizing MonitorShell so product boundary changes touch smaller files.
Move product-intent definitions into a typed config to reduce repeated UI/test edits.
